Interest-based processing of your data and its forwarding to third parties
We process your user data by means of cookies and other analytic and tracking technologies ("Cookies") to optimise the website, create user-profiles and display interest-based advertising. We also access or retrieve information from your end devices. We also pass on some of the data collected in this way to our partners, who may be based outside the European Union, for example in the USA (see "Manage Cookie Settings"). In this context, it cannot be ruled out that your data may also be linked to other data already stored about you. By clicking on the "Agree" button, you consent to the use of your data. You can decline the use of your data by clicking on "Decline". To revoke your consent at any time, also for the future, to change your settings or for further information, click on "Manage Cookie Settings".
